description: Number of Grid-Connected Solar PV Installations by User Type is a dataset listed in Singapore open data portal (data.gov.sg), an open data portal, published or maintained by Energy Market Authority. Note: a. Data for 2021 is as at 1Q 2021. Historical values have been revised with the incorporation of new information on de-commissioned installations and reclassification of installations. More recent statistics for this dataset is available at ema. gov. sg/statistic. aspx? stasid=201707111RdfXbFT9L5m. Coverage: Singapore. The portal files it under the publisher Energy Market Authority. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2024-06-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sg-dgs-portal.
